part: Feature 7 — package open and job load benchmark

budget.scope: ceria fixture, release, benchmark laptop class; not a 512 MiB-package promise

notes: open measures Package::open_readonly including the read-only connection, pragmas, identity/schema checks, and schema_info; the connection is dropped by the benchmark harness.
cold_load_job_1 measures open + load_job(1): schema checks, model decode/mapping/parameterization signature, lattice decode/mapping/signature, job decode/mapping, and column checks.
warm_load_job_1 measures load_job(1) with the decoded model already in the package cache.
All three medians are far below the < 100 ms fixture budget. A 512 MiB payload is bounded by ReaderLimits but may take proportionally longer; the budget is not a large-package promise.
